meta.name: Knight
meta.label: Knight (worldly)
sources: owner t104u: lesser/greater noble serving a king or lord, maybe church-paid, no vows, no Breath
invented: stat numbers (Crusader minus the Order's Breath/WIL edge, plus CHA)
tiers and abilities Liege_Call, Courtly_Bearing, Oath_of_Fealty

Knight.description: Worldly heavy cavalry/infantry: a lesser or greater noble sworn to a king or lord. Same steel as a Crusader Knight, different chains: liege, lands and honour, not Order and Church.
Knight.lore: Knighted by a lord's sword, not raised by an Order. Some take Church pay for a campaign; none take the Order's vows.

obligations.feudal_duty: answer the liege's call to arms; 40 days' service per year (one arc in four)
obligations.honour: noble reputation track; cowardice, broken word or dishonourable fighting cost reputation (no Virtue)
obligations.lands: from Banneret: holdings that need stewardship and attract trouble
obligations.church_pay: may take Church contracts as order_contractor; no vows, no Breath

Courtly_Bearing.effect: +10 Etiquette with nobles; -10 Persuasion with peasants who know him

Liege_Call.effect: once per arc call 1d6 men-at-arms from his liege's levy

Oath_of_Fealty.effect: his own vassals: +10 morale near him; breaking faith with his liege makes him an outlaw

Feudal_Duty.effect: the liege's summons overrides party plans

Honour_Bound.effect: cannot refuse a formal challenge without reputation loss
